recognition.named: spider nest in a stone cellar

blocking: the hanging victims taper to a point above the floor and read as floating columns
evenly dim with too few landmarks: four views are interchangeable
the victims hang so low they stand like pillars
victims too long: columns, not bodies on a strand
the mother is not against the ceiling
cocoons read as carvings in the alcove walls
no bones and no torn silk to be seen
